title: Verify the prior-runtime action receipt on a fresh runtime boundary without promotion leakage
scope: verify the prior-runtime action receipt is readable and cryptographically valid
bind receipt identity to the prior runtime commit and deployment instance
ensure the current runtime cannot self-manufacture its own prior evidence
verify foundation remains PASS and memory remains below 320MiB
keep DB round-trip as a local PASS only
keep source independence and canonical quorum DENY until independently proven
do not open Room 02 or staircase
completion_gate: Prior-runtime receipt verifies on the next runtime boundary with exact identity/hash evidence; current runtime remains non-authoritative for its own prior receipt; S1 remains blocked unless canonical evidence/quorum is independently proven.
successor_instruction: A prior-runtime receipt is evidence of the previous runtime boundary only. Its PASS cannot promote S1, cannot unlock another room, and cannot be inherited by a different gate.
